claimChecks.followUp: Ask Splunk to confirm Essentials entitlement for the target stack.

validationOutcomes.check: Official source inventory and bounded claims
validationOutcomes.detail: All 20 maintained ES URLs and four exact SOAR pairing/release records were fetched. The source and claim records above retain exact sections, scope, dates, outcomes and follow-up. No factual correction was supported.

validationOutcomes.check: Initial synchronization gates and full regression suite
validationOutcomes.detail: All three synchronization gates passed. The first full test run passed 78 of 79 tests; one trust assertion still expected the October 3 site-publication date after the October 4 release note was generated.
The exact trust assertion was advanced to October 4. This is operational publication-metadata coverage, not a product-fact or interface change.

validationOutcomes.check: Live canonical, legacy, themed and invalid routes before publication
validationOutcomes.detail: The canonical ES Editions route loaded 20 capabilities and five evidence questions. The legacy preview alias canonicalized to the same view. The theme=cisco route loaded the theme stylesheet and class. Unknown release/provider/region values were removed and returned to explicit unspecified/default state without becoming verified selections.

validationOutcomes.check: Live conflict disclosure and fixed actions before publication
validationOutcomes.detail: Both Connector Builder statements and both Guided Response scopes were visible, and Copy comparison link, Print / PDF and Save dated snapshot were present. The browser clipboard remained empty after Copy, so native clipboard success was not claimed.

validationOutcomes.check: Live keyboard skip target before publication
validationOutcomes.detail: Keyboard activation changed the URL to #edition-comparison. The browser did not expose a reliable focused-target signal, so focus placement was not marked passed.

validationOutcomes.check: Downloaded HTML snapshot and independent reopen before publication
validationOutcomes.detail: The browser download channel timed out after the Save dated snapshot action; no downloaded file or independent reopen was claimed.
No native print-to-PDF/page-inspection surface was available. Structural print tests are recorded separately and are not treated as PDF proof.
The available browser surface did not expose viewport resizing.
The browser reported no WebMCP tools on the representative ES 8.6-to-8.7 route. Repository contract tests remain separate and do not certify this browser implementation.

validationOutcomes.check: Final synchronization gates and full regression suite
validationOutcomes.detail: All three synchronization checks passed; node --test tests/*.test.cjs passed 79 of 79 tests after the stale publication-date assertion was repaired.

validationOutcomes.check: GitHub, Sites and post-deployment live agreement
validationOutcomes.detail: Publication and post-deployment verification occur after this audit artifact is finalized and are reported as separate run outcomes; this field is not pre-marked passed.
